t: You are looking at Troxy on Commercial Road in Stepney, a Grade II listed Art Deco building. It was built as a cinema in 1933 and closed in 1960. It then became a training school for the London Opera Centre, and in the 1980s it was used as a bingo hall. It was converted to a live events venue in 2006, and its capacity of 3,100 is due to grow to 3,600 in 2026. The architect was George Coles, who is known mostly for Art Deco cinemas of the 1920s and 1930s.
